recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core reconciliation. If confusing -ig argument handling is still observed in the modern IG Publisher, address it in the current publisher/kindling codebase rather than this core specification checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-12410 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core tooling change request reporting confusing IG Publisher behavior: no helpful error when the -ig argument was omitted, and NullPointer failures when run from the same directory as the IG file.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN revision 10443. The migrated Git commit b7a5e37e50140d046c1b27c553611451d9e06f27 is that revision and changed tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.igtools/src/org/hl7/fhir/igtools/publisher/Publisher.java to throw an explicit missing -ig exception and normalize the IG config file path.
additional_context: The affected old in-tree IG Publisher source is no longer present. Commit 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b removed tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.igtools with the summary 'Remove IG publisher (it's gone to Maven)'. Current Gradle configuration depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from that dependency. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-12410 found no evidence changing the Jira/git conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested historical tooling fix already exists in source history, and no current core source owns the affected IG Publisher implementation.
